name: Sierra Nevada Pale Ale
description: An attributed adaptation of the brewery’s published homebrew recipe, with its grain ratios and Cascade addition schedule retained.
notes: Source specifies 92% two-row and 8% caramel 60L rather than a total grain weight; this adaptation assumes 4.5 kg total and 72% efficiency. The source’s 5 US gallon batch is represented as post-boil kettle volume, with zero transfer loss for this template. Uses catalog Briess malts and WLP001 for the source’s generic two-row, caramel and California ale yeast. Cascade weights and 90/60/30/0-minute timings follow the source; the zero-minute addition is flameout, with no assumed hop-stand duration. Source calls for whole cones; this engine has no pellet/cone adjustment. A 170°F (76.7°C), 5-minute mash-out is written here for manual use because the model stores one mash rest. Boil-off, carbonation and pitch settings are app assumptions. Calculated values are this app’s predictions, not the brewery’s specifications.
